cohort: Lamb fetuses with experimentally induced congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH) at 70 days' gestation.
finding: The timing of fetal endoscopic tracheal occlusion (ETO vs. LTO) influences cardiac morphology and molecular markers in lamb fetuses with CDH, with ETO being associated with LV myocardial cell enlargement and increased endothelin-1 and TGF-beta 1 staining.
gest_age: CDH created at 70 days' gestation, ETO at 85 days, LTO at 105 days, and fetuses harvested at 140 days' gestation (term = 145 days).
